name: Encerrados
source:
Our curious protagonist finds that, for the first time, the classroom supply cabinet has been left opened. When she decided to take a look inside, a group of male students arrives, and between them, the guy she likes...
By an accident, both of them were left locked inside and from there you have to choose her ending...

A short game where there are a series of questions and choices to make. There are 10 endings to see.

[Translated from the [url=https://puzzledeluxe.blogspot.com/2014/01/descargar-ejercicio-1-encerrados.html]official website[/url]]
translation:
我们好奇的主人公第一次发现教室的供应柜是开着的。当她决定进去看看时，一群男学生来了，而他们中间，就有她喜欢的男人……
一次意外，她们俩被锁在里面，从那里你必须选择她的结局……

这是一个简短的游戏，有一系列问题和选择。有10个结局可供观看。

[翻译自[url=https://puzzledeluxe.blogspot.com/2014/01/descargar-ejercicio-1-encerrados.html]官网[/url]]
